packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Model catalog builder
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Builds the cached provider and model catalog from the pi-ai registry, hides unservable models and applies the provider allowlist.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-provi.name: Provider allowlist
packages/adapters/src/models/model-provi.description: Reads the deployment provider allowlist and refuses or strips providers it leaves out, including copied bot and routine pins.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: API-key live catalog
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Probes a provider's models endpoint with the user's key and merges new and retired ids into the bundled catalog.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Live model fallback
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Filters chat-model ids and infers a live model's capabilities from its closest bundled sibling.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Live catalog cache
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Provides the stale-while-revalidate cache and the env switch shared by every live catalog fetch.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Registry compatibility patches
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Patches registry models for Google effort levels, Bedrock strict mode, developer role and canonical provider ids.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Custom endpoint provider
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Registers the OpenAI-compatible provider that lets users connect any URL and probe its model list.

packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.name: Shipped model tests
packages/adapters/src/runtime/pi/models/.description: Asserts which OpenAI, Anthropic and Bedrock model ids and effort levels the bundled catalog ships.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-selec.name: Model selection rules
packages/adapters/src/models/model-selec.description: Chooses default models and credentials and validates that a connection can serve a requested model.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-choic.name: Loose model resolver
packages/adapters/src/models/model-choic.description: Lists the models a user can run and resolves a spoken model name to one with deterministic ranking.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-roles.name: Model role defaults
packages/adapters/src/models/model-roles.description: Resolves each purpose's model from the member's choice, falling back to the deployment's.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-setti.name: Connection model settings
packages/adapters/src/models/model-setti.description: Merges saved and compatible-endpoint defaults into the settings a model runs with on a connection.

packages/adapters/src/models/deployment-.name: Deployment default model
packages/adapters/src/models/deployment-.description: Reads the environment's default provider, model and key and the admin-saved override.

packages/adapters/src/models/model-visio.name: Vision support check
packages/adapters/src/models/model-visio.description: Decides whether a catalog or compatible model accepts images, using the registry and sibling fallbacks.

packages/adapters/src/bots/own-bot-setti.name: Bot self-settings
packages/adapters/src/bots/own-bot-setti.description: Lets a bot change its own model and effort by resolving the name then validating the change.

packages/adapters/src/tools/fleet-tools..name: Fleet tools
packages/adapters/src/tools/fleet-tools..description: Gives agents tools to spawn and manage child bots, resolving any requested model first.

apps/api/src/routes/context.ts.name: Route context
apps/api/src/routes/context.ts.description: Builds the per-request catalog by merging auth, live lists, credit offerings and saved selections.

apps/api/src/models/deployment-model-set.name: Deployment model settings
apps/api/src/models/deployment-model-set.description: Lets an admin save the default model and key for everyone, and goes back to the environment's.

apps/web/src/lib/models/model-catalog.ts.name: Web model options
apps/web/src/lib/models/model-catalog.ts.description: Turns credentials and the localized catalog into one list of model options for pickers.

apps/web/src/lib/models/composer-model-p.name: Composer picker preference
apps/web/src/lib/models/composer-model-p.description: Stores whether the message box shows the model picker in local storage.

apps/web/src/components/models/FoundMode.name: Server model picker
apps/web/src/components/models/FoundMode.description: Renders a searchable dropdown of model ids found on a custom server.
